rationale: ZeRO3 only saves trainable params; frozen params silently omitted. Detection compares model.named_parameters() set vs the saved state dict's param-name set (anti-example 12: completeness, not value_equality). Layer is schema_topo_precond: precond is 'ZeRO stage 3 + has frozen params' and check is scoped to checkpoint_save phase, but rule is the same per rank without cross-rank topology. P8 because named_parameters set vs saved-name set is statically observable on each rank at save time. Tier 6 needs named_parameters set field.
